data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Create.Name
data.value: Create an isolated XNCF development task

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Create.Description
data.value: Create a source snapshot. New modules are generated from locally installed templates only inside the isolated workspace; existing modules are copied before editing. Target source is not modified.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Read.Name
data.value: Read an isolated XNCF file

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Read.Description
data.value: Read a text file and its SHA-256 from the specified module in the isolated workspace. Target source and files outside the workspace cannot be read.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Write.Name
data.value: Write an isolated XNCF file

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Write.Description
data.value: Atomically write code files inside the isolated workspace. Project, NuGet, MSBuild, and application configuration files cannot be modified. Send back the SHA-256 from the read operation when possible.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Validate.Name
data.value: Validate an isolated XNCF development task

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Validate.Description
data.value: Validate the module path in the isolated workspace and the direct Senparc.Web reference to the source project, then generate a controlled diff summary.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Preview.Name
data.value: Start a Sandbox XNCF preview

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Preview.Description
data.value: Send a sanitized copy of the isolated workspace to Sandbox for building and execution. If Sandbox is unavailable, the operation fails safely and never falls back to the main-site process.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Status.Name
data.value: Get isolated XNCF development task status

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Status.Description
data.value: Return isolated-workspace, diff, validation, Sandbox-preview, and manual-approval status.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.RequestApproval.Name
data.value: Request manual approval for an XNCF task

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.RequestApproval.Description
data.value: Freeze the current isolated-workspace diff and request administrator approval. This operation does not modify target source.

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Discard.Name
data.value: Discard an isolated XNCF development task

data.name: Function.XncfBuilder.Development.Discard.Description
data.value: Stop the associated Sandbox preview and reclaim the isolated workspace without modifying target source.
